recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It closes the active parallel source omission without broadening the issue into unrelated birthDate elements or external extension-pack work.
issue_request: FHIR-35090 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for FHIR-core Patient asking to remove Patient.birthDate guidance that said an estimated year should be guessed when the real DOB is unknown. The approved wording says partial dates are allowed if the specific date of birth is unknown and retains patient-birthTime guidance for Patient.birthDate.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit 226cf50c64b4737a64a12f90c243f29a52a0e7df applied the approved wording to source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. Current Patient.birthDate still matches the approved text, but a source-wide check found the old guess guidance still present on source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both Patient and Person as active resources, so the Person StructureDefinition is in current build scope. The patient-birthTime extension now lives in the Extension Pack and includes Person.birthDate in its context, but this reconciliation only needed the core Person comment fix. PA minutes reference FHIR-35090, and no conflicting Zulip rationale was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml so Person.birthDate says partial dates are allowed if the specific date of birth is unknown, removing the obsolete instruction to guess a DOB. Patient.birthDate was left unchanged because it already matches FHIR-35090.
source_changes: source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml: replaced the Person.birthDate comment that told systems/users to guess an unknown DOB with partial-date guidance.
